messages.author: 0c859e56c0f49539
messages.subject: Error when calculating pkde and mean
parts:
Hi Chris,
I'm using the latest ctmm package version 1.2.1 and I am running into the same error message when trying to calculate the pkde and mean of AKDEs for two tagged individuals: "Error in `[<-`(`*tmp*`, i, P, value = TRUE) :  no 'dimnames' attribute for array." After calculating the individual UDs at once, the plot seem to look ok. If I calculate the AKDE for each individual separately, the final UDs look ok as well. I'm not sure what should be changed?
The example code and data are posted in the same dropbox location - I can send that location again shortly. Any insights are greatly appreciated!
Cheers,
Connie
